releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.1.8

- OBLIVION, REVEALED: the case now shows its live entry fee directly in logs, rising as your balance grows. Unlock at 500 million logs; no percentage math hidden in the button.
- A FAIR DOOR TO THE VOID: authenticated players without a leaderboard row can still open the case; their permanent relic claim displays a stable Player identity.
- CASE FEEDBACK: failed attempts show the actual service error and refund the exact entry fee. The Oblivion result stays separate from ordinary case rewards.
- The 500M unlock, 1-in-100,000,000 one-of-one odds, +20% maximum axe-skin bonus, and standard chicken sale controls remain intact.
